User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account information, name, email and elite subscription tier status.

uid.description: Unique user ID from Firebase Auth.

displayName.description: Custom user display name or warrior callsign.

isEliteUser.description: Subscription tier status indicating if user has upgraded to Elite.

focusArea.description: The user's current resilience focus area (e.g. Anxiety Management, Emotional Balance, Focus & Drive, Sleep & Rest, Grief & Healing).

dailyTipEmailEnabled.description: Whether the user receives daily morning Resilience Tip emails.

lastDailyTipSentAt.description: Timestamp when the last daily morning resilience tip email was sent.

theme.description: User preferred UI theme preset (e.g. calm-sea, forest-grounding, warm-sunset, midnight-obsidian).

/users/{uid}.description: Documents containing premium subscription tier data and personalized display names.
